title: Homeowners Insurance Rate Pages: Base Rates and Coastal Wind Surcharge
content:
Rates for Homeowners Insurance are annual and are stated per 1,000 dollars of dwelling coverage (Coverage A). Each HomeShield program has its own base rate. Homes in a coastal wind community carry a surcharge on the base premium, stated as a percentage.

## Rate page

| Program | Annual base premium per 1,000 dollars of Coverage A (USD) | Coastal wind surcharge on the base premium |
|---|---|---|
| HomeShield Essential | 3.42 | 35 percent |
| HomeShield Standard | 3.58 | 35 percent |
| HomeShield Plus | 3.96 | 35 percent |
| HomeShield Preferred | 4.21 | 35 percent |
| HomeShield Premier | 4.47 | 35 percent |
| HomeShield Estate | 4.88 | 35 percent |

The coastal wind surcharge is the same 35 percent in all six programs; the base rate rises with the program, from 3.42 dollars under HomeShield Essential to 4.88 dollars under HomeShield Estate.

## Reading the rate page

**Annual base premium.** The annual base premium is Coverage A divided by 1,000 and multiplied by the program's base rate.

**Coastal wind surcharge.** For a home in a coastal wind community, the base premium is increased by 35 percent of itself.

### Worked figures (hypothetical Coverage A)

| Program | Hypothetical Coverage A (USD) | Base premium (USD) | Base premium with the 35 percent coastal wind surcharge (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| HomeShield Standard | 400,000 | 400,000 divided by 1,000 is 400; 400 multiplied by 3.58 is 1,432.00 | 35 percent of 1,432.00 is 501.20; 1,432.00 increased by 501.20 is 1,933.20 |
| HomeShield Preferred | 700,000 | 700,000 divided by 1,000 is 700; 700 multiplied by 4.21 is 2,947.00 | 35 percent of 2,947.00 is 1,031.45; 2,947.00 increased by 1,031.45 is 3,978.45 |

These figures are before any discount.
